four_step_tests.native_text: Define product, customer, and growth engine.
four_step_tests.finding: Facebook/Instagram/Messenger/WhatsApp aggregate consumers; advertisers buy distribution and outcomes. Advertising is almost all revenue; reach, impression growth and monetization drive observed growth.

FoA is strongly profitable, but Q3 margin compressed and capex accelerated. Aggregate DAP growth does not establish advertiser retention; positive segment economics provisionally pass while improving economics/retention evidence is incomplete.

four_step_tests.native_text: Estimate growth duration and competitive moat.
four_step_tests.finding: Scale and potential social/data/advertiser feedback support a credible duration hypothesis. Incremental network benefit and AI ROI are analyst inferences requiring tests; no five-year high-growth guarantee.

four_step_tests.native_text: Compare valuation to multi-year compounding path.
four_step_tests.finding: Five-year earnings and exit-multiple scenarios do not demonstrate enough return margin for a concentrated growth long at the historical reference price. Native Watch retained.
